newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil see minor consolidation.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil see minor consolidation.

text.p: IPE Brent and gas oil futures firmed a little in cautious trade early on Wednesday in consolidation after Tuesday's sharp drop.
July Brent gained nine cents to trade at $19.31 a barrel by 0922 GMT.
Brent lost 78 cents on Tuesday, following New York's lead after U.S. traders interpreted large speculative long positions on the U.S. crude futures market as a sell signal.
London based brokers said they expected to see relatively low volume trade in narrow ranges on Wednesday and this would continue on Thursday unless "the API's affected it."
"We expect to see a couple of days of sideways movement, nothing too major and then the market will be set for a move. It's early to say which way it will go," one commented.
Weekly stock figures for the U.S. from the American Petroleum Institute were scheduled for release after futures markets close on Wednesday.
The focus would be U.S. gasoline stocks and demand, brokers said. The U.S. gasoline market this year has disappointed.
"If the gasoline can't pull this market up, then nothing can. I see the market as fundamentally long and it needs to come down lower still," one U.K. based trader said.
June gas oil recovered some of Tuesday's $5.75 losses, gaining 50 cents to trade last at $172.50 a tonne.
Crack spread margins for gas oil climbed back above $4 for July contracts after Brent's heavy slump on Tuesday.
